title: UE radio capability ID deletion indication

entities.name: UE radio capability ID deletion indication
entities.description: An information element that may be included to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: UE is not in NB-N1 mode
entities.description: Condition that the UE is not operating in NB-N1 mode.

entities.name: Both UE and network support RACS
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and the network support RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: Network needs to trigger UE radio capability ID deletion
entities.description: Condition that the network needs to trigger the UE to delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: Delete UE radio capability IDs
entities.description: Property indicating the UE should delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs stored at the UE for the serving PLMN or SNPN.

relations.description: The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the UE is not in NB-N1 mode.
The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS.
The inclusion of the IE is guarded by the condition that the network needs to trigger UE radio capability ID deletion.
The IE establishes the property that the UE should delete all network-assigned UE radio capability IDs.
